organizational.title: Your Organizational Health Results
organizational.resultsSent: Success! Your results have been sent to your email.

statusMessages.Misaligned: Your organization shows significant disconnection from purpose. Focus on foundational alignment and cultural clarity.
statusMessages.Emerging: Basic structures exist but need strengthening. Prioritize leadership development and cross-functional collaboration.
statusMessages.Stabilizing: Good foundation with room for optimization. Focus on innovation and strategic coherence.
statusMessages.Evolving: Strong organizational health with clear momentum. Continue advancing integration and adaptive capacity.
statusMessages.Thriving: Exceptional organizational alignment and vitality. Maintain excellence while exploring regenerative leadership practices.

painPointMessages.purposeCulture: Your organization's purpose and culture need attention. When these foundations are weak, employees lack direction and engagement suffers. Consider clarifying your organizational values and ensuring they're lived daily.
painPointMessages.collaboration: Cross-functional collaboration is challenging. Silos prevent information flow and slow decision-making. Focus on building bridges between teams and creating collaborative spaces.
painPointMessages.leadership: Leadership effectiveness needs development. Strong leadership cascades positive impact throughout the organization. Invest in leadership development and coaching.
painPointMessages.wellbeing: Employee wellbeing shows strain. Sustainable performance requires healthy, supported team members. Prioritize wellbeing initiatives and psychological safety.
painPointMessages.organizationalStrategy: Strategic alignment needs strengthening. When strategy isn't clear or coherent, efforts scatter and results suffer. Focus on strategic clarity and alignment.

selfLeadershipMessages.0-25: Self-leadership awareness is emerging. This is your foundation for personal and organizational growth.
selfLeadershipMessages.26-50: Developing self-leadership capacity. You're building important personal leadership capabilities.
selfLeadershipMessages.51-75: Strong self-leadership foundation. Your personal leadership is positively impacting your organization.
selfLeadershipMessages.76-100: Exceptional self-leadership. You're modeling conscious leadership that elevates your entire organization.

low.title: Limited Interconnectivity
low.message: Your organizational pillars are operating somewhat independently. While each area may function well, there's opportunity to strengthen connections and create synergy across domains.

strong.title: Strong Interconnectivity
strong.message: Your organizational pillars reinforce each other effectively. This interconnectedness creates resilience and accelerates growth across all areas.
